scope: Active README claims and six mandatory audit categories plus inherited invalidation register. MEASURED labels describe historical source provenance, not a fresh remeasurement. This inventory does not certify all historical prose.

claims.claim: Legacy bytes_transferred is a sum of operation IDs, not transferred bytes.
claims.evidence: Legacy metrics source at accepted H1 commit 5dc125e and its ffi call sites supply IDs such as 300.
claims.restriction: Never use old counter totals as bytes or throughput; raw historical data remains unchanged.

claims.claim: 18.50 ns facade JNI penalty is a printed constant.
claims.evidence: The measured loops use Java array access and Unsafe.getShort; neither loop makes JNI calls.
claims.restriction: No native facade latency or general subclass/reflection compatibility follows.

claims.claim: 15.2 ns JNI and 24.5x penalty derive from constants.
claims.restriction: Retain coarse-boundary hypothesis, discard this empirical speedup claim.

claims.claim: 1848 of 12474 sampled events is an event fraction only.
claims.evidence: Historical M2J event count reported in proposal; raw campaign not rerun here.
claims.restriction: No allocation-byte share, CPU share, rate or total allocation follows without event weights/bytes and sampling model.

claims.claim: P0-8 pack allocation rates and histogram are authored tables.
claims.evidence: Existing invalidation explicitly predates real pack installations; tools/p08_closure_audit.py stores literal histogram rows.
claims.restriction: Do not use as empirical allocator or mod workload evidence.

claims.claim: M3J observed a vanilla hopper/chest/furnace fixture inside Revelation.
claims.evidence: 32 hoppers,32 chests,8 furnaces, natural entities, single world/night/run.
claims.restriction: Call this vanilla storage/smelting plus natural-spawning workload; H16 still needs real mod machines.

claims.claim: M3W5 timing and live-count claims cannot be accepted as currently verified.
claims.evidence: Cited terrain-parity and final-shadow raw receipts are absent from this checkout.
claims.restriction: Invalidated as current acceptance evidence; this does not prove that the historical experiment did not occur. New independent campaign required.

claims.claim: Block-ID equality does not prove zero ULP of intermediate density.
claims.evidence: Harness compares discrete block classifications; many floating-point values map to the same block.
claims.restriction: Compare actual floating-point bit patterns at defined boundaries before claiming zero ULP; no new Mojang translation is authorized.

claims.claim: Historical M2CP reports 57.5 vs129.7 MB/s and39.9% worker CPU reduction.
claims.evidence: Three alternating runs per arm, one machine/pack; slightly asymmetric timing spans and differing chunk mixes; raw campaign not rerun.
claims.restriction: Worker-path result only; no server MSPT benefit or linear multiplayer scaling established.

claims.claim: Median normalized compressed-volume increase is approximately0.9% from rounded run MB values.
claims.restriction: Derived from rounded historical summaries, not matched identical packet streams; README1.5-2.4% was not the M2CP summary.

claims.claim: Historical actual native no-op benchmark records mean8.46ns.
claims.evidence: Committed YAML p95=19.00,min=4.10,max=27.60; earlier prose14.20/3.80/68.40 disagreed.
claims.restriction: Hot batched no-op on one JVM/machine; full application call and transfer costs are separate. No new timing campaign performed.

claims.claim: NewDirectByteBuffer benchmark wraps existing static memory.
claims.evidence: benchRustAllocDirectBuffer does not allocate native payload; it calls new_direct_byte_buffer on GLOBAL_TARGET_BUFFER.
claims.restriction: Latency includes Java wrapper creation; not complete native allocation/copy accounting or optimal architecture proof.

claims.claim: Ratio of no-op JNI and Java lookup timings is not a native NBT benchmark.
claims.evidence: Different operations; native lookup, string handling, lifecycle and identity costs unmeasured.
claims.restriction: Do not claim exact doubling; retain bounded complete-path experiment gate.

claims.evidence: Available report table: immutable input and palette-dependent rebuild. Raw campaign not rerun.
claims.restriction: README2.7us corrected to cited report; no wire or live snapshot speedup follows.

claims.evidence: Available historical summary; no new benchmark here.
claims.restriction: Kernel/coarseoperation scope only; H10 must measure complete generation/callback path.

claims.claim: CachedRustencode andJava packet constructor timing have different boundaries.
claims.restriction: Cannot infer full Java construction or loaded-server speedup from ratio.

claims.claim: Retained native state may remove selected extraction/materialization copies.
claims.evidence: Serializer writes a caller buffer; capture cloning, compression, encryption and socket buffers remain distinct boundaries.
claims.restriction: No measured end-to-end zero-copy claim; count actual complete-path copies and lifetimes.
